notes.title: Aya Update Released
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32506335/c734607d20c386cb8465af50c36d60ddc94e35ff.jpg

Be ready for Update 14 which brings you the fourth and last team member of the Wanted Killer squad. Ladies and Gentlemen, meet Aya :wk_aya: - a deadly assassin who silently takes out her enemies from a distance, making good use of her trusty sniper rifle!

Besides an all-new playable character, we also added 3 new rifles...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32506335/4ea42a52455db266ee10935e3022ef1e5979e081.jpg

...a brand-new map...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32506335/ea57e5f1b341aae1ba42f113ae57397a40e520de.png

...and a wide variety of under-the-hood improvements such as a complete AI overhaul. Here is the full list of what you will find in today's update:

New character Aya, with tutorial and 8 missions
New map "Factory" (playable in campaign)
New enemy "Sniper Rifle Guy"
Returning boss "Spider Mom"
4 new weapons:

Bifrost N10-N50 sniper rifle
Bolt V120-V520 sniper rifle
Medusa S-S5555 sniper rifle
Blazer 5000-9000 laser rifle

AI overhaul
Lobby tutorials
Loot & weapon upgrade overhaul
New art pass on "Docks"
General bug fixes

There you have it guys, we hope you're going to enjoy being Aya as much as we did during our play tests! ːsteamhappyː As always, thanks for all the love and support. Don't forget to let us know what you think about Aya and stay tuned for the final release of the game :wantedkiller:

notes.title: Teo Update Released
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32506335/6ef482d90cde3ae1a3a4c10e44b2d88c2910b777.jpg

Today, we're happy to announce Update 11 which brings you an all-new playable character! Say hello to Teo, a brawler who is most efficient in close quarter combat, taking out foes with his baton and shotgun. Unlike Ricky and Mia, Teo has the unique ability to also teleport to live enemies, giving him a leg-up in point blank situations.

https://i.imgur.com/TIlAahS.gif

We also shuffled some missions around and changed the character selection for certain missions. Our goal was to make sure that the playstyle of the character chosen for a certain mission is in tune with the specific layout of the respective map. For example, did we put Teo in more contained maps such as Ship while Mia will be playing in spacious areas such as Skyscraper. While this does affect your level progression, it will have no impact on your player stats such as character or gun levels.

This means that you might end up replaying missions you have already completed before, but they will feel better and much closer to what we want to achieve with the full release. We understand that losing progress can be frustrating, but we're convinced that in the end you will appreciate the improved quality and enjoy the game even more! 

On top of that, there are also three new weapons...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32506335/d61e0cf6921966e39ad01d07cbb959364468669f.jpg

...and a new enemy type Grenade Gunner:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32506335/031bdc75be3bb8f87b494490ddcc6b4389cfc34d.jpg

As always, you can find the full list of what to find in this update here:


 Teo - new character, with special "charge" teleport ability and baton
 Several missions reassigned, reordered and given new voice over intros for all levels (no new audio for Ricky yet)
 One new mission, for Ricky: "Moonlight Brawl"
 3 new shotgun types:

 "Cobra K" → Acid Thrower Full-Auto Shotgun
 "Model T-101" → Ice Shotgun with spin-around active reload
 "Thunderbird" → Crackling "Shock-Gun"

 New enemy - "Grenade Gunner" (in the new mission, as well as in Horde mode)
 Balancing and elemental effects pass for all guns
 Rifle enemies now fire volleys of fast-moving bullets
 Many new visual effects
 AI behavior tweaks and improvements
 Fixed a bug, where In some situations, settings were failing to save
 Fixed a bug, where players were sometimes able to play missions as the wrong character
 Fixed a bug, where SMG enemies now pop out of cover for longer
 General bug fixes

There you have it guys, we really hope you're as excited about the update as we are! ːsteamhappyː Thanks for all your support and let us know what you think about Teo.

notes.title: Elemental Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32506335/3e62862b20a8cf2b3f3df712b35a8be64f8e491e.jpg
Today we are bringing you our first update for this year and it's all about peace and nature and... new improved ways of eliminating enemies obviously!

Some weapons and enemies now have an elemental affinity according to the following rule set:

Fire weapons (red) deal bonus damage against Ice enemies (blue) and vice versa.
Electric weapons (yellow) deal bonus damage against Acid enemies (green) and vice versa.
All elemental types are weak against their own color. As an example, shooting a Fire weapon at a Fire enemy means less damage.
Armored enemies - some enemies, including all robots, have armor. Rifles as well as Electric and Acid weapons are most effective against these enemy types.

Besides that, the evil corporation Genetic Minds was up to no good once again: Boss Kees van Kloten has been cloned! 😮 His clones are weaker versions of the more powerful boss and now show up in several missions as regular enemies.

As always, you can find the full update list here:

Elemental affinity added to enemies and weapons
Kees van Kloten appears now as a normal enemy in the game and his tougher version is used in a boss level
Mia 2nd hand teleport added
New Boss intros added
Added item drops
Fixed bug where enemies got stuck (Map Subway)
General bug fixes and improvements

Enjoy! And remember that already in February we are adding our 3rd playable character to the game (you can check the remaining Early Acces roadmap here). We already played a lot as Teo internally and boy it is fun! 🤩

notes.title: Co-op is here!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32506335/a8a0a1049800da296042ea4b48e3c752019994fb.png

For the last couple of weeks we have been working hard on the promised co-op feature (you can find the full release roadmap here), so we're very happy to deliver the good news that from now on you will be able to play the game with a friend. Christmas coming early this year! 🎄

Every campaign mission (excluding the initial tutorial) will be playable in the 2 player co-op mode and you will be able to choose any character that you've unlocked. Of course the new feature is also available in horde mode, so try your luck and get to the top of the leaderboard! 

We truly believe this is one of the coolest updates to the game so far, as for the first time ever you will be able to see other players teleporting between opponents and taking them out... in style! Also, what's better than killing bad guys with a friend? 😎

https://i.imgur.com/aMXkIxK.gif

As always, there are a couple of other small changes and improvements to the game which we don't want to hold back from you. You can find the full list here:

Co-op mode added to the game

Two playable characters: Ricky and Mia
Updated lobby to include co-op mode
Updated all weapons for co-op
Tweaked difficulty of missions when played in co-op
Added in-game health bar for players in co-op
Added "Invite Friends" feature for Steam players
Added death, teleport and running animations for Ricky and Mia
Added fast trail renderer
Added new challenges
Updated the pause menu
Updated visuals on the teleporters (hub and characters)
New enemy types added: pistol and rifle guy
Added snap rotate tutorial
Updated visuals on splash screen
Added per weapon headshot multiplier for the freeze pistol
Changed leaderboard icons
Added fast teleport effect
Added visual representation of backpack weapon on player's character
Bugfixes:

Fixed ammo issue for freeze pistol
Fixed collision on ghost weapons
Fixed shield pistol issue where it was firing 3 bullets


Enjoy! And when the time comes, don't forget to celebrate with your friends by gifting them the best thing possible: Wanted Killer VR 🎅🎁

notes.title: Loot Update Released
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32506335/a0162a785d96dd90f54d8c9ff331d571c8129b36.jpg

Update 8 brings you what you've all been waiting for - finally there is LOOOOOOOT ːsteamhappyː

From now on, there are 5 different enemy tiers - higher tiers mean stronger enemies but also a higher chance of a rare weapon drop! Which brings us to... GUNS! There are now 5 different weapon rarities: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary. Within each rarity, there are 5 different levels. You can increase weapon levels by upgrading your guns with gold. Each weapon can be upgraded to level 5.

We have also improved Lobby and changed the loadout screen so you can easily manage all these new sweet guns that you collected. 

Apart from that, we also added new mission and a new boss character “Kees van Kloten”.

And that's still not it. Here is the full list of all changes to be found in this update:

  Added new tier System for weapons, we have now multiple tiers per weapon type: 

  Common
  Uncommon
  Rare
  Epic
  Legendary

  Enemies drop different levels of LOOT
  Added new mission and boss character “Kees van Kloten” 
  Added a new loadout screen with all weapon types and characters
  Redesigned lobby including inventory system
  Added new video tutorials and infographics
  Added holster functionality for primary weapons
  Added backpack to store weapons, ammo, etc.
  Enemies can now have armor on top of HP
  Added different ammo per gun type: 

  Rifle
  Pistol
  SMG
  Shotgun
  Exotic


This is just the beginning of many improvements to add more depth to the game, so stay tuned! Now get back to it and have fun upgrading your weapons 🔫💪

--------------------------------------------------

We just released a patch along with this update bringing you a list of bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements:

Added reload function for exotic weapons (flamethrower and tesla gun)
Added loadout tutorials
Removed health bracelets for improved readability
Equipped Vom Strom with correct tesla gun
Added backpack sounds
Added quick equip buttons in the mission complete screen
Added ammo UI for pistols
Improved regions for grabbing weapons from backpack/holsters
Bugfixes: 

Fixed Windows Mixed Reality controller issues
Replaced SG45 Razorback with correct texture
Fixed a bug with health text rendering on wrist
Fixed enemies occasionally standing around for no reason
Fixed readability for the uncommon weapon names
Fixed VO overlapping
Fixed collision for the tutorial doors
Fixed drone position in Nightfall
Raised HP for the drone in Subway mobile defense
Fixed drone countdown in Mission Sky High

Enjoy!

   Open Sky (4th mission)

notes.title: Nightfall Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32506335/bb481ede851eae5ddd0fd5413a02d50b9717669c.jpg

Update 2 brings a little bit of darkness in the form of an all-new amazing view on our Skyscrapers panorama at night with ambient lights coming from neon billboards and the stars in the sky, giving it an eerie look. You will also have the chance to experience a new mode called "Lightning Strike" for the first time. Don't let GENETIC MINDS grill you alive, so keep teleporting fast enough - or rather slow enough.

It also seems that CEO Kincaid has heard about your recent successes which is why he deployed a new killing machine to stop you once and for all. Welcomes you with bullets: The Drone Storm.  

https://i.imgur.com/VZ1J13W.gif

But that's not all. The generous CEO treated two of his best troopers to better weapons - Superior SMG and Shotgun soldiers received upgrades with two new shiny and even more deadly guns! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32506335/f0bc5b3b9779c328074a9319bb4a420780d38d2e.jpg

And there's still more than that. Here's the full list of what you will find in Update 2 (codename: Nightfall):

 New enemy type "Drone Storm" added: They will keep players on their toes while hovering in mid-air and shooting from above 
 Better enemy weapons: Super Shotgun Guy and Super SMG Guy have new weapons now that are much more powerful and also look badass 
 New setting “Skyscrapers Nightfall" added featuring dramatic lights, neon sign billboards and stars in the sky
 New chapter “Nightfall” with 4 brand new missions added: Dark Sky, Quicksilver, Matrix, Nightfall
 New mission type "Lightning Strike" added: Players will need to teleport in order to reset a death countdown while fighting enemies and surviving for a certain time (missions: Quicksilver, Matrix)
 Lobby improvements: character selection, weapon stats, mission selection
 Minor performance improvements in “Subway”
 Improvements to tutorial mission “Time Manipulation”: objective timer increased by 50%
 Medium difficulty boss fights integrated in earlier levels
 Dougal Burns (Flamethrower Guy) boss fight improved and polished: audio tweaks, spawn position, entrance animation
 VO improvements and new lines added 
 Various smaller UI improvements
 Minor tweaks, bug fixes and improvements

As always, we're very excited to hear your feedback, especially about the new mode!

But wait, there's one more thing. If you look close enough, you might be able to find out who will be joining the WK4 squad in our next big update. Exciting times!

notes.title: Update 1 Released
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32506335/d85d47cd63326e9e97d5da05e693b1548e330703.jpg
Big thanks to all of you who decided to support us and our vision for Wanted Killer VR early on. The team is super excited to share details about our first big content update that we will be releasing later this month. But before that we prepared a bunch of quality-of-life improvements that we think will make the game more fun in the meantime. 

Based on your initial feedback, we noticed that a lot of you guys seemed to have missed the option to manually reload weapons which is why this has been added now. Simply aim your guns straight up and they will reload:

https://i.imgur.com/0wMDQMV.gif

Another comment we received quite often was referring to the enemy AI behavior. Especially the VR pros among you felt there was too much down-time during gameplay, so we went ahead and spiced things up a little.

Here's the full list of improvements and fixes to be found in this update: 

    Manual reload of guns added
    Enemy AI behavior improvements (less down-time during gameplay)
Option to choose between free locomotion head oriented or controller oriented
    Improvements to weapon handling: visuals and functionality
Improvements to Freeze pistol skill (it will be easier to freeze enemies)
    Defense mode rule-set update: Mia’s drone gets attacked by enemies, additional fail condition for clearing the mission (Missions: Commuter, Mile High, Genesis)
    Additional tutorial mission “Time manipulation” added 
    Lobby improvements: 
    
        Campaign restructured into chapters (Tutorial, Legacy, Identity, Revenge)
        More information per mission given on screen such as difficulty of mission & mode
    
    Survival mode lobby tutorial added
    Survival mode leaderboard improvements
    Survival mode mission break-down leaderboard added (no need to leave to HQ to check leaderboard score) 
    Free movement controls improvement for Vive
    Gun hand position fixes
    Fixed right arm positioning bug
    Achievement bugs fixed 
    Minor tweaks, bug fixes and improvements

We will try to hit with these smaller updates every week or two, so feel free to drop ideas for improvements in the comments or discussions section and we will look into them. 

Thanks.

notes.title: Release Date Announced
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32506335/477e15f2d878d9350b0b4fd97b776e0aef209d57.jpg

On May 23rd we’re going to release Wanted Killer VR in Early Access and we hope you're as excited about playing it as we are about finally delivering it into your hands. We have big plans for the game and much more content to add with future updates! But we have to start somewhere, and this is it. Here’s what you will find in the version that we release this week for $9,99 or equivalent:


    Story campaign consisting of 15 missions and starting with a tutorial, so you don't get lost in the game early on. You will follow the story of Ricky as he is the first of our four playable heroes planned for the game.

    3 distinct locations: Genetics Lab, Subway and Skyscrapers. Each one of them offers different playstyle opportunities, spanning from tight horizontal corridors to vertical areas and wide open spaces.

    Survival mode on all 3 locations so you can hone your skills after finishing the campaign and compete with your friends.

    Deep upgrade system. With every mission you will gain XP and gold that will help you develop your character but also upgrade and customize your loadout. More options, more fun!

    Amazing-looking pistols with crazy abilities. When you read pistols, you might think "boring", but then again ours shoot bursts of bullets like Uzis, snipe enemies in cover, shield you when you're flying through the level and freeze enemies. And all of that in bullet time. Trust us, they do much more than pew pew!

    Don't you worry though! We will not leave you with just pistols as that would be unfair considering the bad guys are equipped with well-known classics like SMGs, shotguns and flamethrowers. We even spiced it up a notch with railguns and tesla rifles! All you need to do is eliminate them and grab their guns, easy enough.

    All this comes on top of the features we already announced, like free locomotion (about which you can read in previous post here) and tactical teleportation that lets you create your very own action sequences.


We see Wanted Killer VR's Early Access as a starting point for the game. Where we go from here will highly depend on you. We want the community to be very engaged in the creative process and funnel this passion to make together the best VR shooter possible. Your feedback will be essential to do that, so come join us on this crazy bullet-time ride.

And if you want to know more about Wanted Killer VR check out our newest video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0QuC5DJNhC8

notes.title: Freedom of Movement
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32506335/18a327018a0cd7103a22d97ba32bf9bcdc76ca74.jpg

In Wanted Killer VR, complete freedom of movement is paramount to your survival. At face value, that might not sound much different from other VR shooter titles. However, Wanted Killer VR has a unique blend of locomotion options that allow for truly fluid VR gameplay. 

If you want to move short distances or adjust your cover position outside the reaches of your play area, we provide headset-driven free locomotion via a combination of thumbstick movement and gaze direction.

https://i.imgur.com/PiYXzFI.gif

But that is just covering the basics! We also came up with a new movement system called "Tactical Teleport", which lets you move towards a specific location in bullet-time while the enemy (and their bullets) move in slow-motion.

You can dodge bullets and melee enemies when you are in slow teleport, but you can only change direction by successfully shooting the next teleportation target with your teleport beam. It feels great in VR and is a fun super power that puts you into some very intense situations! 

There are two types of teleportation. Holding down the teleport button will put you into "Slow teleport", while releasing the button will instantly beam you to the target.

Slow-motion Teleport:
https://i.imgur.com/iu8aD9o.gif

Instant Teleport:
https://i.imgur.com/L5XYBPB.gif

Take advantage of this by changing your position to a more advantageous one, like higher ground, or simply to flank the enemy. Teleportation can only be used on specific targets: momentarily after killing an enemy (only while their pink ghost is visible, which will fade within a few seconds), between waves, and within special zones.   

Wanted Killer VR will release this month, so stay tuned for more updates very soon!
